keys.name: colorspaceConfig
keys.text: Absolute path of the OCIO config of the Houdini session (hou.Color.ocio_configPath). On render products published from the farm it becomes colorspaceData.config.path. Local renders take the config from the colorspace settings resolved for the publish context.

keys.name: colorspace
keys.text: Name of the scene_linear role colorspace of the config (for example ACEScg). Extract Colorspace data uses it for representations that have no colorspaceData.

keys.name: renderProducts
keys.text: One entry per AOV, with the AOV name and its colorspace. Used when the farm publish job creates the AOV instances; the colorspace of the entry becomes colorspaceData.colorspace of that AOV.

keys.name: sceneDisplay / sceneView
keys.text: Display and view the artist works with in the application. They are not baked into the pixels. Core reads these names first. Houdini does not write them.

keys.name: colorspaceDisplay / colorspaceView
keys.text: Older names of sceneDisplay / sceneView, written by Houdini (default display and view of the session). Core reads them when the newer names are absent. Used as the transcode target when the profile leaves display and view empty.

keys.name: sourceDisplay / sourceView
keys.text: Display and view that are baked into the pixels. Copied to colorspaceData.display and colorspaceData.view of farm AOVs. No Houdini plugin writes them.

keys.name: colorspaceData.colorspace
keys.text: Colorspace of the pixels in the files. Source of the transcode and of the thumbnail conversion; fills the {colorspace} template key at integration.

keys.name: colorspaceData.config (path, template)
keys.text: OCIO config that defines that colorspace: absolute path, and a template with anatomy root tokens that another machine (for example a farm worker) can resolve.

keys.name: colorspaceData.display / view
keys.text: Display and view baked into the pixels. Inverted as the source by the transcode and used as the target by the thumbnail.

keys.name: colorcorrect, ociocolorspace, ociodisplay, ocioview
keys.text: Color correction of an OpenGL or Flipbook ROP: LUT or gamma, an OCIO colorspace, or an OCIO display and view. This is the actual color state of the review pixels.

keys.name: representation.data.colorspaceData
keys.text: What the integrator stores on the server: the final colorspaceData of each published representation.

steps.title: colorspaceData (read)
steps.subtitle: ExtractOIIOTranscode · +0.019
steps.now: Source = {colorspace: scene_linear colorspace, config}. Runs only when a transcode profile matches the instance (default: no profiles). A target display and view left empty in the profile falls back to the scene display and view.

steps.title: colorspaceData (new repre)
steps.subtitle: ExtractOIIOTranscode · +0.019
steps.now: The new representation is a copy of the source with only the target keys overwritten. A Use Colorspace target keeps the display and view of the source, if it had any. A Use Display&View target keeps the colorspace key of the source next to the new display and view, so colorspace still names the source colorspace and not the colorspace of the pair.
steps.expected: Only the target state: colorspace, or display and view.

steps.title: colorspaceData (review out)
steps.subtitle: ExtractReview · +0.02
steps.now: colorspaceData is copied from the input representation. With the default output definitions the media is encoded with FFmpeg arguments -apply_trc gamma22 and BT.709 flags, so the copied colorspace describes the source image, not the encoded media. It runs for instances with the review family, on representations tagged review.
steps.expected: Colorspace of the encoded media (for example Rec.709).

steps.title: colorspaceData
steps.subtitle: ExtractColorspaceData · +0.49
steps.now: Skipped for representations that already have colorspaceData.

steps.title: colorspaceData (read)
steps.subtitle: ExtractThumbnail · +0.49
steps.now: Converts from the representation colorspace (or its display and view). The target is the display and view of the representation when it has them; otherwise the OIIO defaults of the thumbnail profile (default: colorspace color_picking). Without colorspaceData FFmpeg is used. This plugin and Extract Colorspace data share the order value +0.49, so their sequence is not defined.

steps.title: colorcorrect, ociocolorspace
steps.subtitle: ValidateReviewColorspace · Validator +0.1
steps.now: Optional; skipped when OCIO is not set. Fails when colorcorrect is not an OCIO mode. In OpenColorIO mode it fails when ociocolorspace is neither a colorspace of the config nor an active display, or differs from the Review colorspace setting (when set). In Flipbook ocioview mode, ociodisplay and ocioview are not checked.
steps.expected: Also check ociodisplay and ocioview.
